pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: QwenCloud model page (read 2026-10-03): US$2 input, US$6 output, implicit cache US$0.25, explicit cache creation US$2.50 and explicit cache read US$0.17 per million tokens; one price row, no long-input surcharge shown; Model Studio lists US$2 and US$6 in Singapore and US$1.65 and US$4.951 in Beijing and its other regions; Artificial Analysis shows 2.00 and 6.00 with an 88% cache discount. The Batch API page states a 50% discount for qwen-max, qwen-plus, qwen-flash and qwen-turbo and does not name Qwen3.8 ids. The bare id qwen3.8-max now means the 0902 snapshot.
